text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her sights set on her Twinkle Series 
debut at last, Manhattan Cafe's goal was a 
little different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Namely, to catch up to and surpass the 
"friend" only she could see, whom she had 
been chasing ever since she was a child—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Agnes Tachyon—already praised 
for her immense talent—also prepares for 
her Twinkle Series debut alongside her 
fellow generation members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the expectations placed upon her, 
Manhattan Cafe remained focused entirely 
on her own goal—her "friend."
